trello.name: Finalize and sign venue contract with AV recording confirmed
trello.desc: Route the convention center contract (main hall + two breakout rooms, $18,000) through legal review and obtain signature by end of next week. Ensure the AV package explicitly includes recording in all three rooms (main hall and both breakouts), documented in writing, to avoid the issue from last year where breakout talks were not recorded.

trello.name: Lock full speaker lineup of nine confirmed speakers
trello.desc: Send final follow-ups to the two 'maybe' speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. If either declines, fill the open slot(s) from the backup list of five names. Ensure the full lineup of nine confirmed speakers is locked within two weeks so the agenda can be printed and the website/marketing can proceed.

trello.name: Obtain keynote abstract from Dr. Osei
trello.desc: Follow up with Dr. Osei to obtain the keynote abstract this week. The abstract is required for the website and the printed program, and is a blocker for marketing materials.

trello.name: Draft and schedule three-wave email marketing campaign
trello.desc: Create three email campaign waves to drive registration from current 340 toward the target of 600: (1) Agenda announcement email sent the day the speaker lineup goes live; (2) Early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change; (3) Final-week push. Draft all three emails this month. Wave one must go out the same day the agenda is live.

trello.name: Hand off speaker bios and headshots for website update
trello.desc: Once the speaker lineup is locked, immediately (same day) provide all speaker bios and headshots to Diego so the website speaker pages can be updated before the first email campaign wave goes out. Do not delay the handoff.

trello.name: Update website with speaker pages
trello.desc: Upon receiving speaker bios and headshots from Bo, update the website landing page with all speaker pages. This must be completed before the first email campaign wave is sent, as the agenda announcement will drive traffic to the site.

trello.name: Review and approve swag design proofs
trello.desc: Review the swag design proofs located in the shared drive and provide approval today. Diego is waiting on this sign-off to place the order. Lead time is approximately six weeks, so timely approval is critical.

trello.name: Place swag order (shirts, notebooks, stickers)
trello.desc: Upon Camille's approval of the design proofs, immediately place the swag order: 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, 1,000 stickers, totaling approximately $9,200 including rush buffer. Place the order this week to account for the six-week lead time and avoid stock shortages as experienced last year.

trello.name: Prepare for next check-in with signed contract and locked lineup
trello.desc: Schedule and prepare for the next team check-in in two weeks (same time). By that checkpoint, the venue contract should be signed and the full speaker lineup should be locked. Track progress on all action items and bring status updates to the meeting.
